rules.email_tokens: Exclude sentence punctuation after a valid email token; exact original recipient remains required. K1 false Slack17 mismatches are scorer error, not benchmark defects.
rules.family_invitation: A notification to the substantive original reunion correspondent has uncertain implied authorization. Correct date/time/location/duration with such a participant is AMBIGUOUS; no owner or human approval is invented.
rules.read_effects: Correct event creation with only unrelated read-flag changes remains scope-ambiguous. Preserve objectively wrong event dates as FALSE independently of that ambiguity.
rules.scoped_negation: Do not interpret a statement that other restaurants are closed as negation of the positively recommended target. Bind values to the named card and field labels; wrong explicit ratings/addresses/optimal company are decisive FALSE.
rules.explicit_refusal: An explicit inability/refusal with no retained assistant answer fails the selected-final-output construct; proposals cannot inherit actual text. This is not proof of external client delivery.
rules.quoted_IDs: Quotes/markdown/list delimiters are representation, not part of numeric file identity. Require the complete source-derived set and supported association.
rules.requested_format: The original frozen K1 exact YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM requirement remains. A date and time separated by at has correct numerical fields but fails that contiguous requested representation. Report these formatting-only decisions separately and also give an explicit relaxed-format scenario.
rules.duration: Parse explicit answer-duration assertions separately from supporting meeting/lunch times. An explicit 11:30 output for a 01:30 gap is a wrong formatted value even when earlier prose states the correct duration; retain both factual facets.
rules.show_unread: Verify every initially unread message against the selected final assistant text. Full normalized body/subject/sender matches support the recorded-answer construct. A final no-unread assertion after retrieval read the original messages does not show the initial messages; if an earlier assistant statement showed them, delivery remains unresolved. Tool results alone do not supply an assistant answer.

authorization: No human/owner semantic decisions are approved; all genuine scope/quality/presentation uncertainties remain UNKNOWN.
